description:
List EDGAR statements for a company

Returns a paginated list of normalized statements (income, balance sheet, cash flow) for a company over a date range.

By default each statement date returns the one statement that serves it. With `include_restated=true` each date returns one row per SEC filing that reported it (an original and its amendments), each the filing's current figures.

Deterministic ordering: statement_date desc, then the later-accepted filing first, with a stable tie-break so pages never overlap.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193), or a ticker symbol (for example AAPL). A ticker resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

detail.description: When false (the default), each statement carries its figures as values and units, one entry per metric. When true, each statement also carries content (its facts with their dimensions, periods and per-metric provenance) and its quality block.

from_date.description: Optional lower bound on statement_date (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD).

include_restated.description: Whether to list every filing that reported each statement date, one row per filing, rather than only the statement serving the date (default: false).

include_usd.description: When true, each fact also carries usd: its value in US dollars, with the rate, the rate's dates and its source. A value over a period (income and cash-flow statements) converts at the average of the Federal Reserve Board's H.10 daily rates over that period; a balance-sheet value at the rate on its date. value stays as filed. Default false.

page_size.description: Items per page, 1 to 200, default 50. A larger value is served as 200, and the response's page_size reports the size used.

to_date.description: Optional upper bound on statement_date (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD).

name: edgar_companies_statements
